history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young Southeast Asian woman with long, dark, wavy hair and a bright smile stands on a sandy beach. She is wearing a black string bikini. The ocean water gently laps at the shore around her feet, creating white foam. In the background, the calm sea stretches out to the horizon under a pale, overcast sky. Two small, tree-covered islands are visible in the distance. The lighting is soft and natural, suggesting it might be early morning or late afternoon. The overall mood is relaxed and joyful. The color palette is dominated by the blues of the ocean and sky, the sandy beige of the beach, and the dark contrast of the woman's bikini.
